parts.name: Countertop
parts.Basic_description: The countertop is the top surface of the storage cabinet, made of wood and rectangular in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a flat surface for placing items or performing tasks.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main body structure of the storage cabinet, made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the countertop and encloses the storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structural component and does not move.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and elevates the cabinet from the ground.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Rectangle (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This rectangular part is likely a handle or latch component made of metal.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to open or close the cabinet door.
parts.Movement_description: It may pivot or move slightly when operated.

parts.name: Rectangle (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This rectangular part is another handle or latch component made of metal.
parts.Functional_description: It functions similarly to the other handle, enabling door operation.
parts.Movement_description: It may pivot or move slightly when operated.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is an internal horizontal divider made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage levels inside the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in some designs.
